description: Needs sign-in (connect this server with OAuth, or pass an API key as the Authorization: Bearer header). A YG Dolphin listing's pack versions (serial, status pending/signed/stable/revoked, tier, tree hash), the stable serial, the account's upload quota and its open uploads. The creator's own listings only.
